name: IRQ-16
description: Interrupts. A CPU and blitter based on COPRO-16's, plus a stack, a keypad, a timer, a VEC register for the handler's address and an interrupt controller wired to the timer (irq0), the keypad (irq1) and the blitter (irq2). The fetch routine tests the I condition: with an interrupt pending it pushes the PC and flags, switches interrupts off and jumps to the handler; RTI returns. The main program never has to poll.

programs.name: Three things at once
programs.description: The main loop only counts; a clock, a key counter and the checkerboard all run from interrupts

programs.name: Falling blocks
programs.description: The classic game of seven falling pieces: the timer sets the pace and the blitter draws the squares. Timed for a 250 kHz clock; capture the keyboard on the keypad to play
